mapper.update: UPDATE alarm SET max_prob = CASE WHEN #{result.maxProb} > max_prob THEN #{result.maxProb} ELSE max_prob END, last_detected_ts = CASE WHEN #{result.lastDetectedTs} > last_detected_ts THEN #{result.lastDetectedTs} ELSE last_detected_ts END, detect_count = detect_count + #{result.detectCount} WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACK')
